Professional Experience / Work History  
At NexaCloud Solutions (2022–present), I lead platform engineering initiatives focused on scalable infrastructure and developer tooling. Spearheaded the transition to Kubernetes-based deployments, reducing deployment latency by 35% and improving system reliability. Designed a centralized CI/CD pipeline using GitLab CI and Terraform, streamlining release cycles and reducing manual intervention. Optimized cloud costs by 20% through resource tagging and auto-scaling policies, while maintaining 99.9% SLA compliance. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate PostgreSQL databases with Prometheus/Grafana for real-time monitoring, enabling proactive incident resolution.  

Prior to that, as Senior DevOps Engineer at StreamFlow Analytics (2021), I modernized the infrastructure stack by migrating monolithic applications to microservices architecture. This effort reduced deployment times by 40% and improved resource utilization. I also implemented a robust logging and alerting system using Fluentd and Grafana, decreasing mean time to resolution for critical issues by 25%.  

In my first role as DevOps Engineer at CloudGenix (2019), I focused on automating infrastructure provisioning and managing AWS environments. I developed a Terraform module library that standardized resource creation, cutting provisioning time by 50%. Additionally, I contributed to a Python-based tool for parsing and analyzing API logs, which improved debugging efficiency for REST API endpoints.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Moscow State University, 2019  

Projects / Side Projects  
Developed a Kubernetes-based platform for containerized microservices, enabling dynamic scaling and seamless integration with Prometheus for performance metrics. The solution supported multiple teams and reduced infrastructure management overhead by 30%.  

Created a cost optimization framework for AWS environments, leveraging custom scripts and CloudWatch metrics to identify underutilized resources. This project was adopted company-wide and saved an estimated $150K annually.  

Built a Python API gateway using Flask and Redis, which aggregated data from disparate sources and provided REST endpoints for analytics tools. The project improved data accessibility and reduced query latency by 60%.

Cloud cost optimization: Implemented resource tagging, auto-scaling, and budget alerts in AWS environments, achieving 20% cost reduction.  
Docker: Containerized applications and services, reducing deployment complexity and improving environment consistency.  
Linux administration: Managed server configurations, user permissions, and service orchestration across distributed systems.

Prometheus/Grafana: Set up monitoring dashboards for system metrics, enabling real-time performance analysis.  
Python: Developed automation scripts and APIs for data processing and integration.  
REST API design: Built scalable endpoints for microservices communication and third-party integrations.  
AWS: Architected and managed cloud infrastructure, including EC2, S3, and RDS, with ownership of production environments.  
Kubernetes: Deployed and scaled containerized applications, managed cluster resources, and implemented rolling updates.  
Terraform: Automated infrastructure provisioning, creating reusable modules for consistent environment setup.
